title: Section identity normDet(A∘E)·normDet(S∘ι_K) = normDet(A∘ι_K) (parent steps 2–4, parent (i) and (iv))
statement: Let n, k, N ∈ ℕ, and let A : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ, S : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ and E : ℝᵏ → ℝⁿ be linear maps between Euclidean spaces (ℝʲ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin j)). Let K ⊆ ℝⁿ be a linear subspace with finrank K = k, with the induced inner product and inclusion ι_K : K → ℝⁿ. Assume E z ∈ K and S(E z) = z for every z ∈ ℝᵏ. Then normDet(A∘E)·normDet(S∘ι_K) = normDet(A∘ι_K), where normDet = LinearMap.normDet.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k N : ℕ) (A : Rn n →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N) (K : Submodule ℝ (Rn n)) (S : Rn n →ₗ[ℝ] Rn k) (E : Rn k →ₗ[ℝ] Rn n), Module.finrank ℝ K = k → (∀ z, E z ∈ K) → (∀ z, S (E z) = z) → (A ∘ₗ E).normDet * (S ∘ₗ K.subtype).normDet = (A ∘ₗ K.subtype).normDet
